title: Blueberry Oat Crumble
excerpt: Enjoy a warm, comforting dessert with this blueberry oat crumble. A perfect combination of juicy fruit and a crunchy, golden topping.
imageAlt: Freshly baked blueberry oat crumble in a ceramic dish, showing the bubbling blueberries and the golden, crispy topping.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit) and lightly grease a medium baking dish.

In a large bowl, toss the Fresh Pick blueberries with the lemon juice, one tablespoon of honey and the cornstarch until the blueberries are well coated. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Transfer the blueberry mixture to the prepared dish, spreading it evenly to form the base of the dessert.

In another bowl, make the topping by combining the whole oats, almond flour, ground cinnamon and the pinch of salt. Add the melted coconut oil and the remaining two tablespoons of honey, mixing with your fingers until you get a sandy texture with small clumps.
Sprinkle the oat topping evenly over the blueberry layer in the dish, covering the whole surface.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the oats are golden and the blueberry juices begin to bubble around the edges. Let the dish rest on a rack for 10 minutes before serving so the filling sets.
tips: For this recipe, the firmness and natural sweetness of our high-mountain blueberries, lovingly grown in Guasca, guarantee a juicy filling with the perfect texture without needing to add refined sugars.

If you have leftover crumble, keep it in the fridge in an airtight container. The next day you can warm it for a few minutes in the toaster oven or air fryer to bring back the crunch of the oat topping.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
